attchmntText: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript and Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has submitted the audio recording of the conference call held on November 19, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company previously informed the exchange via a letter dated November 16, 2026, regarding the scheduled call. The audio recording is available for access at the URL https://www.confidencegroup.co/investor-relations/transcript-investor-meeting. The submission was signed by Prity Bhabhra, Company Secretary, on behalf of the company.

attchmntText: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has filed an investor presentation with the National Stock Exchange and the Bombay Stock Exchange pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company states that the investor presentation will be uploaded on its website at www.confidencegroup.co. The filing was submitted by Prity Bhabhra, Company Secretary, on 18/11/2026.

attchmntText: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has informed the Exchange about : Revised Link for Earnings Conference Call
voiceSummary: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has issued a revised registration link for its Q2FY27 earnings conference call scheduled on November 19, 2026, at 04:00 PM. The original Diamond Pass registration link was non-operational due to a technical issue. Investors and participants must use the new registration URL provided in the announcement to join the call. All other details regarding the conference call remain unchanged. The company requests that this information be taken on record.

attchmntText: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has informed the Exchange about Earning Conference Call
Confidence Petroleum India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
